The '''Business and Commerce Quarter''' was the central district of [[Janos]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demar]]. The [[Lant Mining Corporation]]'s [[Administrative Center]] was located in the Business and Commerce Quarter.
